# `company.shipment_drafts`

Draft shipments: the lines, places and numbers that will ship, and their boxes. Move nothing and post nothing. Immutable; the state is the newest revision.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this draft; the shipment it becomes keeps it. |
| `number` | VARCHAR(64) | no | — | unique | — | — | Shipment number, from the shipment sequence; the shipment keeps it. |
| `sales_order_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_shipment_drafts_order | work_documents.id | Sales order the draft will fill. |
| `customer_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | customers.id | Customer or job the goods go to: the order's. |
| `site_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | inventory_sites.id | Inventory site the draft will leave. |
| `pick_list_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | pick_lists.id | Pick list the draft was made from; null when none. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this draft shipment was recorded. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Company principal that recorded this draft shipment. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface that recorded this draft shipment. |
| `audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event that committed this draft shipment. |
